summary: English and Urdu first-party discovery identified the Balochistan Board of Revenue BLRMIS program and its explicit Kech (Turbat Tehsil only) scope. The documented GIS/public components could not be followed to a usable anonymous viewer/API: the named land portal returned HTTP 500 and Board/government hosts returned Cloudflare challenges. No parcel geometry or native identity was retained.
